user.title: Vallox Digit S
user.description: Select the existing ESPHome RS485 connection. Polls measurements and allows manual fan levels 1–8 and eight LED-panel temperature steps. Does not change heater-enable or protection settings. Keep other integrations on the same bus disabled.

init.title: Calculations and maintenance
init.description: Airflow and power are curve estimates. Enter 8 comma-separated values, or 9 with a leading zero. Saving these options never changes device settings. Leave helper fields blank for local maintenance storage.

data.house_area: House floor area (m²; 0 disables DIN reference)
data.heating_power: Heater rated power (W; not measured consumption)
data.minimum_fan_level: Minimum level for every speed control (1–8)

error.invalid_profile: Check values, curves and helper domains.
